comments: Replace with any overall comment. Answers to the six ambiguities belong here or in the per-item comments; they are what unblocks the criteria that reference them.

itemDecisions.comment: Page offers a way to declare the sign-in kind before details are entered.
Both sign-in kinds are offered and are distinguishable.
Choosing organization sign-in changes which details are asked for. Depends on AMB-ETA-351-001.
Password is not readable on screen. Depends on AMB-ETA-351-004.
Correct details reach the Home page. Depends on AMB-ETA-351-006.
Wrong details are refused and reported. Depends on AMB-ETA-351-003.
Missing details are refused and reported. Depends on AMB-ETA-351-003 and AMB-ETA-351-005.
The two failure responses are distinguishable. Depends on AMB-ETA-351-003.
